title: Review panel removed from the UAP Disclosure Act

tellings.quote: Uh, I think that was my biggest disappointment that that was removed from the first version of the UAP Disclosure Act

plain: A review panel meant to force the release of government UFO records was taken out of the UAP Disclosure Act, a bill proposed in Congress in 2023 to make the government open its files on UAP, its term for UFOs. A former Navy fighter pilot named Ryan Graves says this was his biggest disappointment, noting it was removed from the first version of the act. Without that panel, he suggests, the push for disclosure lost much of its teeth.
